I re-ran the same byte audit that produced those two findings across all 22 checkable field-naming claims in findingDisposition: 22 of 22 pass, with no new failure introduced. Everything the earlier cycles fixed still holds — zero D-344 custody claims against nine D-346 ones with basedOn.d346.role the sole claimant, all four currency sentences at leftover-join.v11 of sarif, goldenOutfailV3 demoted to the D-297 historical first-authoring with currency forwarded to sarif-fc-outfail-golden.v5, the v8/v9/v10 landings at leftover-join.v11 of sarif across twelve sites matching live D-345, all four fixture trees guarded, and basedOn.d345 commit-pinned. The measurement is sound: all 80 recordedInputs digests and all 35 basedOn nodes recompute exactly, all ten decision commits resolve to their claimed headings, the four D-346 copies and the eight D-344 copies are byte-identical to their D-297 and D-296 originals across exactly the four G10-quoted platforms with G23 ORDERED-EQUAL and no Windows directory, required-now 28 and the DR-122, DR-107, DR-117, DR-131 and DR-133 tokens match live file 08, the G26 registerRowNote is quoted verbatim, the eleven obligation rows partition cleanly with the sole leftoverDesign-true row matching the roll-up, 292 leftover-join.vN tokens are all lineage-qualified, no disclaimer speaks as a predecessor, no deictic appears, and no SATISFIED is claimed. Six candidate objections were raised and refuted against bytes rather than assumed away, the nearest of them being that findingDisposition.codexV12Landing's carries-forward clause names leftover-join.v13 of sarif where three sibling entries name the speaker — true as written, failing no byte check, and independently certified twelve times over in this candidate's own bytes. leftover-design of OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX remains open on FC-OUTFAIL.committed-run-preserved under the section 7.1 RunId park, the candidate binds NOTHING, and nothing is recorded as current. Under ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, the verdict is ACCEPT.
